To overview

FLORIAN 2026

8. - 10. October 2026
Events
October 8 - 10, Dresden, Germany
25.08.2026

Come and visit Rosenbauer at the trade fair for Fire Brigades, Civil Protection and Disaster Control in Dresden. At Stand F40 in Outdoor Area 4, you can explore a selection of key products and new releases from the fields of vehicles, fire-fighting technology and equipment across a total area of 640 m². 

The Rosenbauer team looks forward to welcoming you to the 25th anniversary of FLORIAN Dresden! 

Further information on FLORIAN Dresden can be found here.
